author: John Hammond
description:
I was messing around with Codex and a Minecraft mod on a live stream, trying to get it talking to the Hunt.io API.

The API key was configured, and I was working on adding more tooling so the setup could figure out which listings were coming from Hunt.io without me having to manually provide IP addresses, websites, or port numbers.

Full video: https://youtu.be/Jx0G9IQxc4s?si=Q0DQzM2_ns0-YfZo
title: Hunt.io Meets Minecraft
